episodes.synopsis: Regent’s sunflower seeds have gone missing. Mohawk’s cheeks are suspiciously large. You do the math.
episodes.title: Delinquent Hamsters

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk has claimed the sleeping hut as his own, but Regent ain’t gonna take that lying down… because he wants to lie down in that hut, dammit!
episodes.title: Turf War

episodes.synopsis: It’s time to decide, once and for all, who’s the most hardcore delinquent around.
episodes.title: Tall Tales

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk and Regent have a way with the ~ladies~.
episodes.title: Lady Friend!

episodes.synopsis: There’s a new hamster in town. He’s got a great perm, but it takes more than a punky haircut to be a delinquent. Regent and Mohawk gotta take this ‘kohai’ under their wing…
episodes.title: Introducing Kohai

episodes.synopsis: History repeats itself… only this time Kohai is along for the sunflower-seed-covered ride.
episodes.title: Delinquent Hamsters Kablam!

episodes.synopsis: What the hell is that pink thing??
episodes.title: Dusty Bro

episodes.synopsis: The hamsters shove sunflower seeds into their mouths to see who’s most delinquent. Yes, that makes perfect sense. SHUT UP.
episodes.title: Showdown

episodes.synopsis: Playtime’s over, and the delinquent hamsters mean business — because they want more freakin’ playtime!
episodes.title: A Battle for Freedom

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents’ sleeping arrangements get a major upgrade. Chaos ensues. I mean, what’d you expect? For the hamsters to just get along or whatever? HA HA HA… no.
episodes.title: A Good Night's Sleep

episodes.synopsis: Kohai climbs to new heights. And then he can’t figure out how to get down again. WHOOPS.
episodes.title: Youthful Indiscretion

episodes.synopsis: Hamsters are definitely the most impressive animals around, right? Right?? … RIGHT?!?!!
episodes.title: Impact

episodes.synopsis: Do not underestimate the powers of the cushion. Not even delinquents are immune to its sorcery!
episodes.title: The Cushion

episodes.synopsis: GET OFF OUR TURF YOU STUPID PIGEON.
episodes.title: The Uninvited Guest

episodes.synopsis: Regent has a …special… way of claiming a carboard tube as his own. Ewwwwwww.
episodes.title: The New Toy

episodes.synopsis: Kohai plummets to new depths. And then he can’t figure out how to climb out again. How the hell does he keep getting himself into these situations??!
episodes.title: Youthful Indiscretion 2

episodes.synopsis: Kiyomasa comes calling. He needs advice from the delinquents. It goes about as well as you’d expect from a show like this.
episodes.title: Individuality

episodes.synopsis: What the heck is that wheel thing??
episodes.title: Mystery Object X

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents acquire a clubhouse. Chaos ensues. What, you’re surprised? You really need to stop expecting better of these hamsters, dude.
episodes.title: The Brown Stadium

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents try a new food. They… like it? Maybe? It’s hard to tell, honestly.
episodes.title: The Cherry Incident

episodes.synopsis: Operation Sweet Potato is underway, and (predictably) Kohai gets the short end of the stick… er, potato? Spit-covered tissue bridge? Maybe? Something like that.
episodes.title: Operation Baked Potato

episodes.synopsis: DIDN’T WE SCARE YOU OFF LAST TIME??? UGH! GO THE HECK AWAY, YOU STUPID PIGEON!!!
episodes.title: Battle at the Window

episodes.synopsis: Temperature control in the sleeping hut is Serious Business for delinquents.
episodes.title: Butt Kicking

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents find another clubhouse. We’ll give you three guesses as to how that goes, and the first two don’t count.
episodes.title: The Brown Stadium 2

episodes.synopsis: Man, that cushion really messes up the delinquents’ image, doesn’t it? But it’s just so soooooft…
episodes.title: The Call of the Cushion

episodes.synopsis: Kiyomasa returns for more advice, against all odds and his own best interest.
episodes.title: Samurai Hamster

episodes.synopsis: Kohai reveals an innovative method of storing food… very familiar-looking food… HEY, WAIT A MINUTE —
episodes.title: The Missing Treats

episodes.synopsis: THE HAMSTERS RAP. The hamsters rap in this episode; what else is there to say?? They’re hamsters and they rap.
episodes.title: Fluffy Rapper

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk has a tummy ache. Regent and Kohai rush to the rescue. Delinquents take care of their own!
episodes.title: Tummy Crisis

episodes.synopsis: WHAT THE?! THE PIGEON IS BACK AGAIN?!? OH, THAT DOES IT. TIME TO BRING OUT THE BIG GUNS (and maybe the bob haircuts, though hopefully things won’t come to that).
episodes.title: Bob Cuts By the Window

episodes.synopsis: Wait. What happened to everybody’s hair? And why is everybody acting weird?! WHAT IS HAPPENING???!
episodes.title: Dreams of Bobs

episodes.synopsis: Temperature control in the sleeping hut is still Serious Business for delinquents.
episodes.title: Butt Kicking

episodes.synopsis: Operation Melon is underway, but this time Kohai won’t let Regent and Pompadour make a fool of him!
episodes.title: Operation Melon

episodes.synopsis: Hot weather leads to a hair disaster for the delinquents. Especially Regent and Mohawk.
episodes.title: Ultra Humidity

episodes.synopsis: The hamsters go for a midnight stroll. Let’s just hope their shenanigans don’t wake Kinkuma…
episodes.title: Midnight Escape

episodes.synopsis: Kohai can’t sleep. Luckily Regent and Pompadour are having some very entertaining dreams. Where’s the popcorn when you need it…
episodes.title: Delinquent Dreams

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents need a leader, so they host an election. Too bad they’re really bad at math…
episodes.title: A Delinquent Election

episodes.synopsis: Two cookies. Three hamsters. The delinquents aren’t great at math, but even they know those numbers don’t add up.
episodes.title: Tale of Two Cookies

episodes.synopsis: Winter is coming. If they’re to survive, the delinquents must train their brains!
episodes.title: My Name

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents discover a weird device. It rumbles… sometimes. Guess they gotta bide their time with a wordgame…
episodes.title: The Shaking Machine

episodes.synopsis: There’s an interloper on the delinquents’ turf! Good thing gutsy Kiyomasa is there to back them up.
episodes.title: The Shogun Hamster

episodes.synopsis: Playtime’s over, but once again, the delinquents aren’t giving playtime up without a fight!
episodes.title: A Battle for Freedom - Winter

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents receive a confusing Christmas present. Dude, it’s like looking in a mirror…
episodes.title: Christmas Eve Punks

episodes.synopsis: “Delinquent.” What does it mean? And who’s that mysterious figure coming this way??
episodes.title: Delinquent Style

episodes.synopsis: Gramps (a new, old friend) shares his wisdom with the delinquents. Will Regent, Mohawk and Kohai become delinquents once again?
episodes.title: Gramps Style

episodes.synopsis: Kohai has gained weight. No big deal… except now he gets extra playtime. Regent and Mohawk hatch a plan to cash in on the fun…
episodes.title: A Plump Ham or Fat Kohai

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk doesn’t appreciate snacktime the way that he should. Regent and Kohai investigate.
episodes.title: Gourmet Musketeers

episodes.synopsis: Regent has a bad hairday, with unexpectedly straitlaced results.
episodes.title: Side Parted Melancholy

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents discuss the true meaning of Valentine’s Day.
episodes.title: Valentine's Day Delusion

episodes.synopsis: What the hell is that loud thing??
episodes.title: Vacuum Bro

episodes.synopsis: …what is Kohai’s real name, anyway?
episodes.title: His Name

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk’s sneezing fit puts his very identity in danger! The delinquents jump into action, but can they save his signature haircut?
episodes.title: Sneezing Fire

episodes.synopsis: It’s time for the 19th Show and Tell with Namippo! Who will walk away the victor of this cutthroat competition?
episodes.title: Show and Tell

episodes.synopsis: Gramps lost his most precious hair! The delinquents are on the case and will replace it come hell or high water!
episodes.title: An Important Hair

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents are graduating… but what are they graduating FROM, exactly?
episodes.title: Spring Has Come

episodes.synopsis: An insidious serpent has stolen the delinquents’ sunflower seeds. THIS WILL NOT STAND!
episodes.title: Get Those Seeds!

episodes.synopsis: Kohai has a dream. It’s weird. But then again, things are rarely ever normal with these hamsters. Better get used to it.
episodes.title: Kohai the Daydreamer

episodes.synopsis: Real delinquents build their own hideouts; everybody knows THAT! But not everybody has brains as small as these hamsters…
episodes.title: Specialty Planning

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk’s bed-head changes him. Or does it? Nobody’s sure. Maybe he’s just grumpy. Oh well.
episodes.title: The Center Part

episodes.synopsis: Kiyomasa is on a quest to find the perfect sword. He goes to the delinquents for help. Probably not the best decision he could’ve made, but you do you, samurai-hamster.
episodes.title: Excalibur of Mine

episodes.synopsis: Gramps introduces / senryu poetry form / to the delinquents
episodes.title: My Narrow Road

episodes.synopsis: Regent is dead set on changing his name, but he’s going to need some time to adjust — and so will Mohawk and Kohai.
episodes.title: Their Name

episodes.synopsis: Yet again, the delinquents have hidden behind the tissue box in protest of a shortened playtime. Will Mohawk’s stinky breath save them where so many plans have failed before?
episodes.title: Playtime Crusade

episodes.synopsis: The cure for boredom? Karaoke. It’s very delinquent.
episodes.title: Rodents Got Talent

episodes.synopsis: The N-1 Grand Prix begins! …oh wait, you don’t know what that is. It’s a contest to make Namippo laugh. Yeah. That’s it.
episodes.title: N-1 Grand Prix

episodes.synopsis: Man, these hamsters’ voices don’t sound anything like they used to, do they? The delinquents take a walk down memory lane to see how much they’ve really changed…
episodes.title: We Young Hams

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents decide to PUNish their audience in the most heinous way possible. Truly, these are the most hardcore delinquents in the world.
episodes.title: Riddles

episodes.synopsis: Hot weather leads to a hair disaster for the delinquents. Especially Kohai.
episodes.title: Ultra Humidity Strikes Back

episodes.synopsis: Regent and Mohawk undergo a transformation that thoroughly confuses Kohai.
episodes.title: Voice Swap

episodes.synopsis: Time to make a wish! But what should the delinquents wish for, anyhow?
episodes.title: Smooth Bavarois

episodes.synopsis: Kiyomasa has a dark secret (one that isn’t really a secret at all, but don’t tell him that).
episodes.title: Wondering Samurai

episodes.synopsis: Gramps is a hide-and-seek champion and no one will ever find him (or at least these dummy delinquents won’t).
episodes.title: Hide and go Weep

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents have come up with an ingenious new way to extend their playtime… but they’ve vastly overestimated their brilliance. Like, seriously.
episodes.title: Playtime Defense

episodes.synopsis: A nighttime escapade. That’s nothing a trio of delinquents can’t handle… b-but wh-what’s th-that sh-shadow o-over th-there?!?!?
episodes.title: Flight or Fright

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents try a new food. The process is just as dramatic as you’d expect.
episodes.title: The Kiwi Incident

episodes.synopsis: What the heck is this super hot spot?!?!
episodes.title: Summer Sweat-off

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk’s hair soars to new heights as he dreams a really weird dream. Like, it’s seriously strange.
episodes.title: Mohawk the Daydreamer

episodes.synopsis: Namippo is back, and he’s looking to take a Delinquency 101 class from the delinquents themselves.
episodes.title: Delinquent 101

episodes.synopsis: Regent wants to add a title to his name, but you can’t just give yourself a title. The delinquents will have to band together to think up something great!
episodes.title: Titles

episodes.synopsis: Regent and Mohawk have eaten all of Kohai’s snacks, and he’s out for revenge. Will Regent and Mohawk FALL for his tricks?
episodes.title: Delinquent Autumn

episodes.synopsis: Forget senryu. Gramps is all about tanka poetry now! Hell yeah!
episodes.title: Ham-ham Tanka

episodes.synopsis: Time for another round of elections! It’s Regent vs. Kohai, and Mohawk wields the power of the vote. FEAR MOHAWK’S INFINITE MIGHT AS A CONSTITUENT!!!
episodes.title: Another Delinquent Election

episodes.synopsis: Happy Halloween… but wait. What IS Halloween, exactly? Kiyomasa has the inside scoop.
episodes.title: Halloween Dilemma

episodes.synopsis: The sleeping hut has gotten super cramped, so it’s time to do some tidying up. Can the delinquents bear to part with their stuff, though??
episodes.title: Serious Cleaning

episodes.synopsis: Any good delinquent needs some muscle, so the hamsters are gonna get J A C K E D.
episodes.title: Getting Fit

episodes.synopsis: First humidity, and now this?!?!
episodes.title: Static Panic

episodes.synopsis: What the heck is this super cold spot?!?!
episodes.title: In Search of Warmth

episodes.synopsis: Can’t… reach… COOKIE…
episodes.title: Fine Lounging Weather

episodes.synopsis: The rumbling thing is back! How come Regent gets to stand in the best spot?
episodes.title: Smartphone Bro

episodes.synopsis: Chris Moose is upon us once again! It’s that time of year when Santa brings presents to good little hams, and the delinquents have been very… uh… um… UH OH.
episodes.title: Chris Moose is for Good Hams

episodes.synopsis: Happy New Year! (Om nom nom.) It’s time to make some resolutions. (Om nom nom!) What do you think the delinquents will do this year? (OM NOM NOM!)
episodes.title: A New Year

episodes.synopsis: Does Kohai have what it takes to pass the Delinquency Exam? Wait. Do delinquents even take exams? THIS IS PARADOXICAL AND CONFUSING.
episodes.title: Delinquency Exam

episodes.synopsis: It’s Valentine’s Day, but what’re the delinquents supposed to do when there aren’t any girls around?
episodes.title: More Valentine's Day Delusions

episodes.synopsis: Namippo is back for more delinquent lessons, and this time he’s here for a new hairdo… but with the delinquents for stylists, things are bound to get weird.
episodes.title: Delinquent 201

episodes.synopsis: Regent wakes up early (for once) and discovers something interesting about Mohawk.
episodes.title: Sleep Shouting

episodes.synopsis: Ah, spring. The time for graduation and moving on… wait, why is Regent making it sound like this show is ending? But we have so many episodes left!!
episodes.title: Spring Has Sprung!

episodes.synopsis: Kohai has a very important decision to make. Luckily Mohawk and Regent make it easy for him.
episodes.title: Club Recruitment

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents deserve better snacks, dammit, and they’ll have to pull out all the stops to get ‘em!
episodes.title: Better Treats

episodes.synopsis: Well, great. This ding-dang butterfly just HAD to visit on the same day as Kiyomasa! Looks like the delinquents will have to scare the interloper off… by any means necessary.
episodes.title: The Samurai and the Butterfly

episodes.synopsis: In celebration of our 100th episode, it’s “Well-mannered Hamsters!” Will the delinquents enjoy this new twist on an old fav? (Hint: Probably not.)
episodes.title: Well-mannered Hamsters

episodes.synopsis: Mohawk just wants to enjoy summer, dammit! Can the delinquents help him feel those good summer vibes?
episodes.title: Summer Feelings

episodes.synopsis: Daddy brought bananas for the hams! But do bananas taste better now, or will they taste better later? Gramps has the inside scoop.
episodes.title: The Call of the Banana

episodes.synopsis: What are midsummer check-ins all about, anyway? What even ARE they, really? And why the hell is Kohai so damn evil???
episodes.title: Take this Summer Greeting!

episodes.synopsis: But wait; there’s more! Now it’s time for… Delinquent Shopping!
episodes.title: Delinquent Shopping

episodes.synopsis: Uh oh. Looks like the delinquents went and pissed off Smartphone Bro! But what have they done to make him so mad?
episodes.title: Smartphone Bro 2

episodes.synopsis: Kiyomasa tries to talk some sense into the delinquents regarding their latest scheme. It backfires. It really, really backfires.
episodes.title: Samurai Blues

episodes.synopsis: The delinquents decide to invent their own version of rock-paper-scissors. Too bad “woodchips-sunflower seeds-Mohawk’s butt hair” doesn’t have the same ring to it.
episodes.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors

episodes.synopsis: TRICK OR TREAT! Hand over all your snacks and nobody gets hurt!
episodes.title: Delinquent Halloween

episodes.synopsis: Regent’s insomnia leads to unexpected entertainment (but what else is new?).
episodes.title: More Delinquent Dreams

episodes.synopsis: A role reversal inspires a look into the delinquents’ past. Look how much they’ve grown! D’awww!
episodes.title: Youthful Finale
